events.name: onSend
events.description: Fired before Thunderbird sends a calendar email (invitation, reply, cancellation) without a compose window. The listener decides what happens.

sender.description: Address of the identity Thunderbird would send from.

actor.description: Address the calendar acts as: the attendee in a reply, the organizer in an invitation.

calendar.description: The iCalendar part as it will be sent.

returns.description: action: send (unchanged), rewrite (from identityId to the addresses in to), or anything else to drop it.
